c74object.name: touch.status
c74object.digest: 2D spatial preset morph grid and modular snapshot controller
c74object.description: Modern touch-first 2D spatial preset interpolator and state manager for Cycling '74 Max 9 (v8ui / jsui). Configurable as a 1D strip or 2D matrix (Cols/Rows) supporting continuous spatial morphing across snapshots, floating long-press slot name stamping palette, integrated 4-slider grid ticker sub-window, standardized 280 px dual-mode 50/50 Attrui parameter inspector, HSV color picker, and dynamic, zero-configuration auto-synchronization with pattrstorage and the package states repository.

inlet.digest: Slot recall, float morph, text stamping, or configuration messages
inlet.description: Accepts integers (1-based slot recall), floating-point numbers (continuous 1D/2D interpolation across slots), slash-delimited topology strings (4/1, 2/2, 1/8), text renaming commands (text, rename, names), utility triggers (popup, palette), and all configuration attributes.

outlet.digest: Commands to [pattrstorage] (recall, store, read, write, name)
outlet.description: Direct command bridge to pattrstorage. Outputs slot index integers, continuous float morph positions, 2D bilinear recall weights ([recall slotA slotB ratio]), snapshot store triggers ([store N]), and automatic absolute state disk operations (name, read, write).
Outputs set [slot name] whenever a slot is recalled, stamped, or renamed. Connects directly to message boxes, comment, or UI displays.
Dedicated storage stream outputting targeted name, read, and write commands with full disk path resolution whenever module identity is updated or presets are saved.

method.name: int
method.description: Recalls the specified slot, highlights the cell, and transmits the integer to pattrstorage.

method.name: float
method.description: Interpolates smoothly across the slot array. In 1D mode, values from 1.0 to N morph linearly between adjacent snapshots. In 2D mode, normalizes across rows and columns.

method.name: grid / layout
method.description: Configures the slot layout topology. Accepts slash notation (e.g. 3/1, 4/1, 2/2, 6/2, 1/8) or two integer arguments defining column and row counts.

method.name: text
method.description: Renames the currently active slot, triggers a snapshot store command, and executes an auto-write to the module state file.

method.name: rename
method.description: Modifies an entry in the preset name bank library without stamping it immediately to an active slot.

method.name: rename_slot
method.description: Directly renames slot index, stores the current parameter state into that slot, and triggers an auto-write.

method.name: names
method.description: Replaces the entire floating palette name bank with a new list of name strings.

method.name: add_name
method.description: Adds a single new name to the floating palette name library.

method.name: palette
method.description: Opens or closes the floating 330x380 Name Palette picker window used for rapid slot stamping.

method.name: popup
method.description: Opens, closes, or toggles the floating parameter inspector window.

method.name: update
method.description: Reloads and re-renders visual palettes from the global shared memory theme bus (Global("touch_theme_bus")). Also accepts aliases theme_update, refresh, and refresh_theme.

method.name: ping
method.description: Forces the object to broadcast its slot names, topology, and active morph ratios to touch.statusmanager via the shared wireless bus. Also accepts alias rebroadcast.

attribute.name: name
attribute.description: Defines the unique module identity for this object. When modified, automatically binds pattrstorage and auto-saves/reads the corresponding <name>.json file inside the package /states directory.

attribute.name: grid
attribute.description: Defines the slot matrix topology formatted as Columns/Rows (e.g. 3/1, 4/1, 2/2, 1/8).

attribute.name: name_bank
attribute.description: Comma-separated or quoted string defining the available preset names displayed inside the floating Name Palette stamping window.

attribute.name: allow_hold_edit
attribute.description: Enables or disables long-pressing a slot cell to launch the floating Name Palette picker.

attribute.name: hold_threshold
attribute.description: The duration in milliseconds required to hold down on a slot cell before the Name Palette window opens (clamped $\ge 150$ ms).

attribute.name: label_mode
attribute.description:
Text abbreviation algorithm applied to slot labels:
0 = Full (complete label string rendered)
1 = No Vowels (strips inner vowels while preserving initial characters)
2 = Caps Only (extracts capital letters and digits; falls back to initials)
3 = First Letter (extracts the first letter of each word)
4 = No Text (suppresses text rendering completely)

attribute.name: case_mode
attribute.description:
Text capitalization normalization:
0 = First Cap (Title Case)
1 = All Cap (Uppercase)
2 = All Small (Lowercase)

attribute.name: font_style
attribute.description:
Font posture and weight:
0 = Regular
1 = Bold
2 = Italic
3 = Bold Italic

attribute.name: font_name
attribute.description: Name of the font family used to render slot numbers and labels.

attribute.name: text_size
attribute.description: Base point size of rendered slot labels (clamped $\ge 8$ pt).

attribute.name: border_radius
attribute.description: Curvature radius of the outer chassis body and corner reticle arcs.

attribute.name: border_thickness
attribute.description: Stroke width in pixels of the outer corner reticle brackets.

attribute.name: border_extension
attribute.description: Length in pixels of the corner bracket arms extending along chassis edges.

attribute.name: bg_color
attribute.description: RGBA fill color of the main status chassis background.

attribute.name: border_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the outer corner reticle brackets and slot cell outlines.

attribute.name: highlight_color
attribute.description: RGBA active fill color for recalled slots and continuous spatial morph interpolation.

attribute.name: text_color
attribute.description: RGBA typography color for slot names and index labels.

attribute.name: popup_dot_color
attribute.description: RGBA color of the upper-right corner inspector launcher dot.

attribute.name: allow_popup
attribute.description: Enables or disables the red inspector launcher dot and ctrl-click access to the inspector window.

attribute.name: show_settings_attrs
attribute.description: Master toggle to show or hide the 50/50 attribute list inside the pop-up inspector window.

attribute.name: mask_performance
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the Grid Matrix, Hold-to-Edit, and Hold Timing section in the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_labels
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of Label Style, Case Style, and Font Styling in the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_geometry
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of Border Radius, Reticle Thickness, and Extension controls in the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of Chassis Background, Border, Highlight, and Text Colors in the inspector.

attribute.name: mask_popup_colors
attribute.description: Toggles visibility of the 5-color inspector UI theme palette section.

attribute.name: pop_bgcolor
attribute.description: Base background fill color for the floating inspector window.

attribute.name: attr_bg_color
attribute.description: Background fill color for individual 50/50 attribute rows.

attribute.name: attr_border_color
attribute.description: Outline and slider trough stroke color inside inspector rows.

attribute.name: attr_slider_color
attribute.description: Active fill color for attribute drag gauges and number ticker columns.

attribute.name: attr_text_color
attribute.description: Font color for parameter names and numerical values inside the inspector.
